title: Hypersurface presentation of an affine function field over a field
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], let Y be affine [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let p:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(K) be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There exist n and Q\in K[t_1,\ldots,t_n] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] such that Z=\operatorname{Spec}(K[t_1,\ldots,t_n]/(Q)), with its coefficient-induced map q to \operatorname{Spec}(K), is geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced. There is a ring isomorphism e:\operatorname{Frac}(\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y))\to\operatorname{Frac}(\Gamma(Z,\mathcal O_Z)) such that e(\iota_Y(p^*a))=\iota_Z(q^*a) for every a\in\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}(K),\mathcal O), where \operatorname{Frac}(R) denotes localization at all non-zero-divisors and \iota_R is its canonical map. No descent to a nonfield base is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0559 (more-morphisms.tex, lemma-geom-irreducible-generic-fibre), first proof, separating field generators and primitive numerator of the minimal polynomial

proof.text: The affine section algebra B is finitely generated and geometrically integral over K. Localizing B at its nonzero elements identifies its fraction field L, and tensoring this localization with any field extension preserves its domain property. Thus L/K is finitely generated and separably generated.

Choose a separating transcendence basis t_1,...,t_r and a primitive element z for the finite separable extension L/K(t_1,...,t_r). Remove the content of the numerator of the minimal polynomial of z to obtain Q over K in r+1 variables. Gauss lemma gives an injection K[t,T]/(Q) into L with fraction field L. For a purely transcendental extension choose the extra variable with equation T.

The same quotient after each field extension embeds into the localized geometrically integral B; its spectrum is therefore geometrically irreducible and reduced. The two fraction fields identify with L fixing K. Transporting the canonical section-ring identification for Spec K gives the displayed compatibility.

proof_origin.note: Specialized and expanded from the source; the finite-type and integral clauses are proved separately in the parent module.

theorem exists_field_hypersurface_function_field_model
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y]
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [LocallyOfFiniteType p]
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible p) (hred : GeometricallyReduced p) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K),
      let Z := Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K ⧸ Ideal.span {Q}))
      let q : Z ⟶ Spec (.of K) := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {Q})).comp MvPolynomial.C))
      GeometricallyIrreducible q ∧ GeometricallyReduced q ∧
        ∃ e : FractionRing Γ(Y, ⊤) ≃+* FractionRing Γ(Z, ⊤),
          ∀ a : Γ(Spec (.of K), ⊤),
            e (algebraMap Γ(Y, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(Y, ⊤)) (p.appTop.hom a)) =
              algebraMap Γ(Z, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(Z, ⊤)) (q.appTop.hom a)
